scripts.text:
[Butterfly Merchant]
Hey, nice to meet you.
I'm selling {0}, do you want to buy it?
scripts.translation:
[蝴蝶商人]
你好，很高興見到你。
我在賣{0}，你想買嗎？

scripts.text:
[Grace Operator]
Hello.
We have ^4d4dffGrace^000000 equipment that can be exchanged for {0}.
I will guide you to exchange items according to your job.
scripts.translation:
[格蕾絲操作員]
你好。這裡有^4d4dff格蕾絲^000000裝備，可用{0}兌換。
我會根據你的職業，協助你兌換物品。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
The Rebellion is using this building for the moment.
Along with a few others around it.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
反叛者暫時借用了這棟樓，還有周圍的幾棟建築。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
We haven't been this busy for a long time.
I don't like that we're working with the President and the company, but it still feels good to be busy with something.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
我們已經很久沒有這麼忙了。
雖然我不喜歡和總統以及公司合作，但忙碌起來的感覺還不錯。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
So, you received the message. The Captains are having a meeting on the inside. Captain Elena Volkova must have called you.
... I was going to call her, but she's already here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
看來你收到訊息了，隊長們正在裡面開會。
一定是埃琳娜·沃爾科娃隊長叫你來的。
...我正要叫她，她倒已經來了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
The Rebellion is using this building for the moment.
Along with a few others around it.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
反叛者暫時借用了這棟樓，還有周圍的幾棟建築。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
We haven't been this busy for a long time.
I don't like that we're working with the President and the company, but it still feels good to be busy with something.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
我們已經很久沒有這麼忙了。
雖然我不喜歡和總統以及公司合作，但忙碌起來的感覺還不錯。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Did you bring Damaged Weapons? Would you like to see that science criminal? He's in there. Want me to call him for you?
Or do you have business with me? I can exchange Weapon Modification Devices and Armor Modification Modules.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
帶武器殘骸來了嗎？
想找那個科學罪犯？他就在裡面，要幫你叫一聲嗎？
還是說，你是來找我的？
我這裡可以兌換武器改造裝置和防具改造模組。

scripts.text: See Elyumina.
scripts.translation: 見艾露米娜

scripts.text: Request Weapon Modification Device.
scripts.translation: 申請武器改造裝置

scripts.text: Request Armor Modification Module.
scripts.translation: 申請防具改造模組

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Okay, enjoy your conversation.
It took a long time to coax him, but he eventually agreed to modify our weapons and armor. He's pretty good at it, too. He's been working all day, every day.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
好，你們慢慢聊。
好不容易才把他說動，答應替我們改造武器和防具。
他手藝確實不錯，每天從早忙到晚。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Do you want a Weapon Modification Device? It's 5 {0} or 1 million Zeny.
Your bag is full. Please make some room first.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
你要武器改造裝置嗎？價格是5個{0}或者100萬Zeny。
你的背包滿了。請先騰出一些空間。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Do you want a Weapon Modification Device? It's 5 {0} or 1 million Zeny.
If you want a weapon, you can talk to Elyumina.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
你要武器改造裝置嗎？價格是5個{0}或者100萬Zeny。
如果你想要武器，可以去找艾露米娜。

scripts.text: Request Weapon Modification Device (Physical).
scripts.translation: 申請武器改造裝置（物理）

scripts.text: Request Weapon Modification Device (Magic).
scripts.translation: 申請武器改造裝置（魔法）

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
I can randomly give you a {0},
{1},
or {2}.
Which one do you have, 5 Cor Cores or 1 million Zeny?
5 Cor Cores
scripts.translation: 5個核心元件

scripts.text: 1 million Zeny
scripts.translation: 100萬Zeny

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
There seems to be a problem. Please check if your bag has enough free space, and you have all the exchange materials you need.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
似乎出了點問題。
檢查一下背包空間夠不夠，兌換材料有沒有帶齊。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
You don't have enough Cor Cores. Please check your bag again.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
你的核心元件不足。請再次檢查你的背包。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
There seems to be a problem. Please check if your bag has enough free space, and you have all the exchange materials you need.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
似乎出了點問題。
檢查一下背包空間夠不夠，兌換材料有沒有帶齊。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
You don't have enough Zeny. Please check your wallet again.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
你的Zeny不足。請再次檢查你的錢包。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
I gave you the best I had left.
If you want to refine it, the <NAVI>[Tin Can]<INFO>sp_cor,106,136,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> next to me can take good care of you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
剩下的好東西都給你了。
想精煉的話，就找我旁邊的<NAVI>[鐵罐]<INFO>sp_cor,106,136,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，他能幫你辦妥。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Do you want an Armor Modification Module? It's 30 {0} and 5 {1}.
The kind you get is randomly decided.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
要兌換防具改造模組嗎？
需要30個{0}和5個{1}，模組種類隨機。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Do you want an Armor Modification Module? It's 30 {0} and 5 {1}.
Your bag is full. Please make some room first.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
要兌換防具改造模組嗎？
需要30個{0}和5個{1}。
你的背包滿了，先騰點空間吧。

scripts.text: Request Armor Modification Module.
scripts.translation: 申請防具改造模組

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Feel feel to talk to me if you want Armor Modification Modules.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
如果你想要防具改造模組，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Each Module requires 30 Mysterious Components and 5 Cor Cores. You don't have them all. Please check.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
每個模組需要30個神秘零件和5個核心元件。
你的材料沒帶齊，再檢查一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
There seems to be a problem. Please check if your bag has enough free space, and you have all the exchange materials you need.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
似乎出了點問題。
檢查一下背包空間夠不夠，兌換材料有沒有帶齊。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
I gave you an Armor Modification Module.
If you want to refine it, the <NAVI>[Tin Can]<INFO>sp_cor,106,136,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> next to me can take good care of you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
防具改造模組給你了。
想精煉的話，就找我旁邊的<NAVI>[鐵罐]<INFO>sp_cor,106,136,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，他能幫你辦妥。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Argh! Why do you keep asking for me when I need to focus on my research? I'm busy, alright? If you're bored, go bring me more damaged weapons!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
啊，煩死了！我正專心研究呢，怎麼老找我？
我很忙，聽見沒有？
閒著沒事就再去給我弄些武器殘骸來！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Didn't you come for weapons or armor? Your bag is full. I don't have time to wait for you while you rummage through your bag. Come back later.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你不是來找武器或防具的嗎？你的背包滿了。我沒時間等你翻背包。稍後再來吧。

scripts.text: - Your bag is full. Please make some room, and then talk to me again. -
scripts.translation: - 你的背包滿了。請騰出一些空間，然後再來找我。-

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
What is it so important that you had to interrupt my research? This had better be important.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
什麼事非得打斷我的研究？
最好真有要緊事。

scripts.text: Request OS Weapon.
scripts.translation: 請求OS武器

scripts.text: Request Illusion Armor.
scripts.translation: 請求幻象防具

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
OS weapons? I'll handle that if you bring me 1 {0} and 50 {1}.
I'll give you whatever kind I want to give you, among the ones I have. Why should I let you pick?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
OS武器？帶1個{0}和50個{1}來，我就給你弄一把。
至於給哪把，我這裡有什麼、想給什麼就給什麼，憑什麼讓你挑？

scripts.text: Exchange OS Weapon.
scripts.translation: 兌換OS武器

scripts.text: Check the available list.
scripts.translation: 檢視武器列表

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Tsk, tsk. I said everything I make is good. Do you really have to choose? Alright, then listen up.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
嘖嘖，我做的哪把不是好武器？
非得挑是吧？好，那就聽著。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
I told you, bring me 1 Damaged Weapon and 50 Mysterious Components. You should listen when people talk.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
說過了，帶1個武器殘骸和50個神秘零件來。
別人說話要好好聽啊。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
... What the? There's a problem.
Not on my end, of course. This is on you. Check if your bag is full or you have all the materials you need.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
...怎麼回事？出問題了。
當然不是我這邊，是你的問題！
看看背包是不是滿了，材料帶齊了沒有。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
There. If you want another, then bring me more Damaged Weapons and Mysterious Components.
I'm locked up in here, fixing toys, because of you. You can deal with this, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
拿去吧，還想要就再帶武器殘骸和神秘零件來。
都是因為你們，我才被關在這裡修玩具。
這點事總該辦得到吧？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
If you want Illusion armor, bring me 50 {0}. I'll give you a piece.
Let's see... Ooh, when did I make so many varieties? Alright, I feel generous. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
如果你想要幻象裝備，給我50個{0}。我會給你一件。
讓我看看...噢，我什麼時候做了這麼多種類？好吧，我心情不錯。你想要什麼？

scripts.text: Illusion Armor
scripts.translation: 幻象機甲

scripts.text: Illusion Engine Wing
scripts.translation: 幻象推進翼

scripts.text: Illusion Leg
scripts.translation: 幻象戰靴

scripts.text: Illusion Booster
scripts.translation: 幻象助推器

scripts.text: Illusion Battle Chip
scripts.translation: 幻象戰鬥晶片

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Alright, {0}, right? Do you really want to trade it for 50 Cor Cores?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
好的，{0}，對吧？你確定要用50個核心元件交換嗎？

scripts.text: Exchange.
scripts.translation: 兌換

scripts.text: Do not exchange.
scripts.translation: 不交換

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Hey, are you kidding me? Hey, I tried to be nice!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
嘿，你在開玩笑嗎？嘿，我明明已經夠客氣了！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Hey, are you kidding me? You don't have all the Cor Cores! Hey, I tried to be nice!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
嘿，你在開玩笑嗎？你沒有足夠的核心元件！嘿，我明明已經夠客氣了！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Here, take this {0}. I bet it's probably the best armor you've ever had. You really ought to be grateful.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
拿著，給你的{0}。
這大概是你穿過的最好的防具了，可得好好謝我。

scripts.text:
You can't proceed with the conversation because you have a large quantity of items.
Please organize your items and try again.
scripts.translation:
由於您持有的物品數量過多，無法繼續對話。
請整理您的物品後重試。

scripts.text:
[RS26]
{0}.
Welcome, Welcome!
Explore the devices.
scripts.translation: 探索裝置

scripts.text: Enchant Illusion Armor.
scripts.translation: 附魔幻象機甲

scripts.text: Enchant Illusion Engine Wing.
scripts.translation: 附魔幻象推進翼

scripts.text: Enchant Illusion Leg.
scripts.translation: 附魔幻象戰靴

scripts.text: Enchant Illusion Accessory [R]
scripts.translation: 附魔幻象飾品 [右]

scripts.text: Enchant Illusion Accessory [L]
scripts.translation: 附魔幻象飾品 [左]

scripts.text: ^0000FF# I'm the latest hologram technology perfected to show natural responses and gestures. #^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF# 我採用最新的全息投影技術，能夠展現自然的反應和動作。#^000000

scripts.text:
[RS26]
My technology can only be found in future cities. I am RS26, a Regenschirm robotic machine.
scripts.translation:
[RS26]
我的技術只存在於未來都市。
我是RS26，雷根席爾姆的機器人。

scripts.text:
[RS26]
If you bring Illusion equipment with strengthening modules, I will improve them as you desire.
scripts.translation:
[RS26]
帶來幻象裝備和強化模組，我就能按您的需求強化裝備。

scripts.text:
[RS26]
Since these modules work with the standard equipment, they will not destroy the items. However, the number of upgrades can vary depending on the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[RS26]
這些模組適配標準裝備，因此不會損壞物品。
不過，不同裝備的強化次數上限也不同。

scripts.text:
[RS26]
Please come back if you need my help~
scripts.translation:
[RS26]
如果您需要幫助，請隨時回來找我~

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.translation: 普通等級

scripts.translation: 稀有等級

scripts.translation: 獨特等級

scripts.text: Legendary Grade.
scripts.translation: 傳說等級

[RS26]
I'm stopping here.
scripts.translation:
[RS26]
到此為止。
